title: CTS Pentecostal and Charismatic Theology — Unit 3: Jesus as Savior, Sanctifier, Spirit-Baptizer, Healer, Coming King

en: Unit 1 - Pentecostal Theology as Encounter: Sources and Method

stem.en: How does the lesson answer the objection that the Full Gospel adds to the gospel?
